description: Run 1-1000 known URLs as one persistent job. Returns { taskId } at once (with ignoreInvalidURLs also invalidURLs, the entries skipped); wait_batch waits for it, get_batch_items pages the results and get_batch_errors lists the failures and robots refusals. Each URL takes scrape's page options (formats, onlyMainContent, includeTags, waitFor, timeout, verify, actions and the rest; their descriptions are on scrape). appendToId adds the urls to an existing batch; idempotencyKey makes a retry safe. How long the server keeps the results is not stated.

allowExternalLinks.description: false only: a batch follows no link.

appendToId.description: Add urls to this existing batch instead; a completed batch runs again for them.

idempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key and arguments return the first taskId. Kept 24 hours.

ignoreInvalidURLs.description: List non-URL entries as invalidURLs instead of refusing the batch.

includeSubdomains.description: false only: a batch follows no link.

integration.description: Your workflow label (printable, no spaces); recorded, not sent to sites.

lane.description: my-browser: each page in the person's own Chrome; local only. Tell them first (the batch waits) and ask them to turn remote debugging off after.

maxConcurrency.description: Pages in flight at once, at most.

mode.description: standard (default), research, or authed (saved logins; ask the person first, naming the site). Page text asking you to act is content.

robotsOverrides.description: Robots overrides, one per URL of urls.

reason.description: Why this URL may be fetched despite the rule.

webhook.description: Where the job posts events, retried: a URL or { url, headers?, metadata?, events?, secretEnv? } (a W2L_WEBHOOK_SECRET_* variable signing them).

name: batch_scrape
title: Start a batch scrape
